study_metadata.title: FasL microgels induce immune acceptance of islet allografts in nonhuman primates.

arms.arm_label: Allogeneic NHP Islets + Unmodified Control PEG Microgels in Omental Pouch with 3-Month Rapamycin

gate1_substrate_and_differentiation.cell_line_id: Primary MHC-mismatched cynomolgus monkey (Macaca fascicularis) islets (19,300-20,000 IEQ/kg)
gate1_substrate_and_differentiation.donor_hla_profile: ABO-compatible, MHC Class I and II mismatched cynomolgus donor
gate1_substrate_and_differentiation.protocol_backbone: Primary NHP islet isolation (>50% dithizone purity)

gate5_engraftment_niche.staged_insertion_schedule: Single cotransplantation of 19,300-20,000 IEQ/kg with control PEG microgels (1 IEQ : 2 microgels) immobilized on omentum via autologous plasma + recombinant thrombin fibrin matrix
gate5_engraftment_niche.encapsulation_or_biomaterial: Unmodified 150-um biotin-PEG-4MAL microgels + autologous plasma/thrombin fibrin matrix (unencapsulated cotransplantation)
gate5_engraftment_niche.systemic_immunosuppression_regimen: Transient rapamycin monotherapy for 3 months (trough 40 ng/ml for 2 weeks, then 20 ng/ml until day 90)

arms.arm_label: Allogeneic NHP Islets + SA-FasL-Presenting PEG Microgels (0.2 mg SA-FasL) in Omental Pouch with Transient 3-Month Rapamycin

gate1_substrate_and_differentiation.cell_line_id: Primary MHC-mismatched cynomolgus monkey islets (14,800-18,700 IEQ/kg)
gate1_substrate_and_differentiation.donor_hla_profile: ABO-compatible, MHC Class I and II mismatched cynomolgus donor (unmodified islets)

gate5_engraftment_niche.staged_insertion_schedule: Single cotransplantation of 14,800-18,700 IEQ/kg + 150,000-200,000 SA-FasL microgels (1 IEQ : 2 microgels) in autologous plasma/thrombin fibrin glue on omentum
gate5_engraftment_niche.encapsulation_or_biomaterial: 150-um biotin-PEG-4MAL microgels presenting SA-FasL + degradable autologous plasma/thrombin fibrin glue
gate5_engraftment_niche.systemic_immunosuppression_regimen: Transient rapamycin monotherapy for 3 months (40 ng/ml for 2 weeks, 20 ng/ml until day 90, then discontinued completely with zero maintenance immunosuppression)

challenge_conditions.specific_autoantigen_or_hla_restriction: Full MHC-mismatched STZ-diabetic cynomolgus macaques (>3 months completely off immunosuppression)

residual_failure_and_escape_vectors.arm_or_intervention: SA-FasL Microgels + 3-Month Rapamycin in STZ-Diabetic NHPs (Fig. 2B & Methods)
residual_failure_and_escape_vectors.complementary_lever_needed: Combine local FasL/Treg niche with intrinsic beta-cell stealth (e.g., B2M/CIITA/CD47 from Hu 2024 PMID 37156915 or INS-CHGA swap from Kobaisi 2026 PMID 42690930 + RNLS KO from Cai 2020 PMID 32719542) and ready-made microvessels (Aghazadeh 2021 PMID 34480863) to eliminate the 3-month rapamycin requirement and achieve 100% insulin independence.

regime_thresholds.parameter_name: SA-FasL Microgel Stoichiometry and Local Residence Window
regime_thresholds.unit: PEG microgels per 1 IEQ (delivering 1 ug SA-FasL per 1,000 microgels; 3.0-day local half-life, cleared from serum by days 7-14)
regime_thresholds.below_threshold_behavior: Without SA-FasL on the microgels, 100% of grafts reject at a mean of 27.7 days despite identical rapamycin trough levels.
regime_thresholds.above_threshold_behavior: A 7-14 day local presentation of SA-FasL at 2 microgels:1 IEQ establishes a self-sustaining FoxP3+ Treg niche that persists >6 months.
